30/G.goal: Explain how human auditory perception and binaural localization support the design and rendering of immersive XR audio.
30/G.achieves: It enables the learner to understand and implement the auditory component of an XR system with attention to human factors, serving the course aim of building XR applications with confidence.

30/O1.goal: Explain the human perceptual principles that guide auditory design in XR.
30/O1.achieves: It enables the learner to select and justify auditory effects based on human perception, which supports the course focus on psycho-physiological user issues.

30/O2.goal: Explain the perceptual and technical basis for binaural sound localization in XR.
30/O2.achieves: It enables the learner to evaluate or implement localized binaural audio that supports presence and cybersickness considerations in the auditory component of an XR system.
